verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own integration docs say it uses an integration to map users and check whether a user with access has offboarded, which covers part of the leaver-access element of the story. The 'Monitor Access Checks' and JumpCloud pages appear only as titles, with no supporting detail. missing for 10: HR-synced onboarding checklists, evidence of training-completion tracking for new hires, automated access-revocation proof across systems, a documented end-to-end offboarding workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, onboarding and offboarding are compliance events — HR-synced checklists prove every hire got training and every leaver lost access

citations.quote: It helps Sprinto to map and check if the user with access offboards the organization.
